reasons.plausibility: The formation of stable oxide phases and a protective passive film under the stated processing conditions is plausible, though the exact composition and uniform distribution of the barrier phases remains somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: Measuring oxidation kinetics and corrosion parameters of samples sintered at different temperatures provides a clear experimental path to verify whether the predicted structural and property changes truly arise.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis proposes a well-defined processing sequence and a concrete set of measurable outcomes, offering a practical framework to guide further research on Mg-containing high-entropy alloys.
